Phase-1-tests/ingest-extraction solution (Implementer choice per the brief): additive IngestOptions.extract?: boolean DEFAULT TRUE (CLI ingest extracts per the phase doc). All Phase 1 ingest call sites updated to pass extract: false with an explanatory comment (tests/phase-01.test.ts header + call sites; tests/tui/phase-01-screens.test.tsx passes extract={false} to IngestScreen via its new additive extract prop) — Phase 1 stays Layer-1-only, key-less, and $0. When extraction is enabled but ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is missing, callLLM's clear API error ('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is not set...') propagates out of ingest — no silent skip. Alternative considered and rejected: env-detection auto-skip, because with the key loaded it would have made Phase 1 tests silently burn LLM tokens and made behavior env-dependent.

Additive CLI flag --no-extract on `ingest` (forward-compatible opt-out for Layer-1-only runs without a key); --verbose now also lists the written .state/extracted/*.json files. IngestResult gained the additive `extractions` array (per-chunk entity/relationship/claim counts); the existing shape is unchanged.

Shared extraction path: src/commands/extract-chunk.ts extractDocumentChunk(wikiDir, chunkId) is used by BOTH ingest (after writing each chunk) and the TUI screen — ingest re-reads the document page it just wrote so there is exactly one extraction/save code path; chunk text = gray-matter-stripped page body, page range + source file from the page frontmatter, AGENTS.md = wiki constitution, rolling memory read-only.

Rolling memory is READ-ONLY in Phase 2 per vision 04 §5 (the Materializer updates it in Phase 3): src/state/rolling-memory.ts readRollingMemory maps folderStructure -> existingFolders and entities[].slug -> existingEntities, tolerates absence (-> empty lists), throws a descriptive error on malformed JSON (same contract as ingestion-state.ts).

TUI screen flow per §5.1 mock: wiki selector -> chunk selector -> action panel ([ Run Extraction ] default-focused, [ Back ]) -> results panel (counts, up to 10 entity name (type) lines, 'JSON saved to .state/extracted/<chunk-id>.json', [ View JSON ] [ Back ]) -> scrollable JSON viewer (Up/Down scroll, PageUp/PageDown page, line x-y of z indicator). Escape steps back json -> results -> chunk -> wiki -> menu. extractChunkFn prop is injectable (same pattern as add-pdfs pickFiles) so TUI tests never call the LLM. useInput gated on isRawModeSupported === true; non-TTY static fallback renders wiki list + buttons + 'requires a TTY'.

Prompt engineering for gate reliability: the prompt keeps the phase doc §2.1 fixed text (8 rules + page format + citation format) in substance, adds an explicit OUTPUT FORMAT section (exact JSON shape with inline examples: John Smith/john-smith/entities/people/executives/$42.5 million claim/March 15 2024 timeline), JSON-only rule ('any text outside the JSON object breaks the pipeline'), page-range rule, existing-state reuse rule (existing entity -> reuse slug + existing folder; prefer existing folders), and an empty-chunk rule. The extractor still tolerates one wrapping code fence defensively (stripCodeFences) though the prompt asks for raw JSON.

Extra deterministic tests beyond the 12 gates (tests/phase-02.test.ts, all LLM-free): 11 validator cases (valid shape, non-object root, missing arrays, bad folder prefix, '..' traversal, 5-segment depth rejection, 4-segment acceptance, page out of range, non-number page, single-page range, unparseable range skip, bad slug/empty type, extended-field enforcement, claim entities type), slug normalization + fence stripping + parseExtractorJson (incl. ExtractorError carrying rawResponse) + ExtractorError issues, rolling-memory reader (absent/present/malformed), and ingest extract:false (no .state/extracted/ written).

TUI test harness note: non-interactive Ink writes only the final frame on unmount, so the View-JSON test unmounts while the viewer is open, and Escape-from-viewer is asserted in a separate test via the re-appearing results buttons.

No new npm dependencies. The Extractor is the only LLM call in the pipeline: src/agents/ contains only extractor.ts; no Materializer/DOX Writer/entity-page/rolling-memory-write code exists. Windows shellout rule untouched (no shellouts added).
